description: This file implements a checkpoint server interface in C, including socket connection handling, process checkpointing and waking up, with functions for connecting to a server via UNIX or TCP sockets, sending commands, and processing responses.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a server specified by a locator string, supporting UNIX and INET sockets, with a timeout.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to the server and receives a response, handling socket connection, write, and read operations with timeout.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a checkpoint (hibernate) process for a given PID, communicating with the server and returning status codes.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up a process with a given PID by communicating with the server, handling specific response codes.
